units.source_text: 平安神宫的“时代节” [2] 也是有名的。

en.t: Heian Shrine's "Festival of the Ages" [2] is also well known.

units.source_text: 这座神宫是为了纪念距今一千多年以前在京都建都的桓武天皇，于明治二十八年（一八九五年）营建的。

en.t: This shrine was built in Meiji 28 (1895) to commemorate Emperor Kanmu, who founded the capital in Kyoto more than a thousand years ago.
The shrine buildings do not have a very long history.

units.source_text: 不过，据说神门和外殿是仿当年平安京的应天门和太极殿建造的。

en.t: However, the shrine gate and outer hall are said to have been built after the model of the Otenmon Gate and the Daigokuden Hall of old Heian-kyo.
It has a tachibana orange tree on the right and a cherry tree on the left.

units.source_text: 昭和十三年还把迁都东京之前的孝明天皇的座像一并供奉在这里。

en.t: In Showa 13, a seated statue of Emperor Komei, who reigned before the capital was moved to Tokyo, was also enshrined here.

units.source_text: 很多人就在此地举行神前婚礼。

en.t: Many people hold Shinto wedding ceremonies here.
